query: How to operationalize an end-to-end interview→survey pipeline: item generation, cognitive interviews, translation/back-translation, pilot sample size, and criteria to revise versus drop items?

response.query: How to operationalize an end-to-end interview→survey pipeline: item generation, cognitive interviews, translation/back-translation, pilot sample size, and criteria to revise versus drop items?
response.answer: To operationalize an interview→survey pipeline: generate items, conduct cognitive interviews, perform translation/back-translation, pilot with a sample size of 30-50, and revise items based on feedback, dropping poorly performing ones.
